kicker: SAVE YOURSELF YEARS IN THE GYM
title: 6 gym truths nobody tells *beginners*

items.head: Sleep is the strongest PED
items.sub: Under 7 hours and your lifts stall on any program.

items.head: 80% of your body is diet
items.sub: You can't out-train a nightly delivery order.

items.head: Intensity beats volume
items.sub: 1 or 2 sets close to failure beat 5 easy ones.

items.head: Track every lift
items.sub: If the numbers don't go up, neither does your muscle.

items.head: Getting toned isn't real
items.sub: Light weight for 30 reps just tires you out. Stay at 5 to 15.

items.head: Soreness isn't progress
items.sub: More weight in your log is progress.

text: Two hard workouts a week is enough to *make real progress.*
